_what: The subject heading Los Angeles Mission College's catalog prints above each subject's first course, read for the local subject titles (Sam's rule on #3655: a local subject title comes only from the catalog's subject heading). Filed by kb/_file_subject_headings.py from a headings read; `heading` is saved in Title Case (Sam, 2026-11-21) with `heading_printed` as the catalog prints it; `above` holds the lines as printed, `rule` how the heading was taken (named, caps, fits or none), and `code_fits` whether the code's letters run in order through the heading, a second signal that decides nothing.
